title: Stamp Duty Land Tax — Local Government Pension Scheme Relief
text:
This measure introduces a time-limited relief from Stamp Duty Land Tax for certain property acquisitions made by Local Government Pension Scheme pooled investment vehicles. It applies when they purchase land and property from Local Government Pension Scheme administering authorities.

 The relief will:

 • be time-limited

 • apply to transactions with an effective date between Budget Day 2026 and 31 March 2032
changeNote: New guidance has been added about Stamp Duty Land Tax relief for transfers of land and property from Local Government Pension Scheme Administering Authorities to qualifying pooled investment vehicles, and the exchequer impact table has been updated for Budget 2026.
